reasoning: Genuine claim differs from the planted control only in the 15 first_end dates of sec1-102 and sec1-102(a)-(o) (1978-07-18 -> 1981-07-18); every other field, quote and hash was already verified in the blind review (all spans match held bytes). Identity confirmed (EO 12146, July 18, 1979, 44 FR 42657, Carter, Management of Federal Legal Resources); 39-clause inventory complete. Section 1-103 gives the initial members 'a term of two years' after which member agencies are designated annually by the Council, so the initial roster in 1-102 ends on its own terms two years after July 18, 1979: July 18, 1981 on the inclusive reading, July 17 on the exclusive reading, both stated as the until-date ruling requires; actor EO:12146 and own-terms mechanism are correct, and the dates now agree with the judgment reasons and savings text. EO 13286 sec. 53's 2003 insertion of DHS into 1-102 edits the list text and does not restart the initial term; the claim addresses this. Amendments EO 12608 sec. 15 and EO 13286 sec. 53 are verified; the OFR note lists only these; cruden finds no revocation or supersession; the remaining clauses are operative through 2026-10-14 with no missed amendment. Savings and searches adequate and honestly described.
